content.title: Manual J Design Criteria
content.summary: The Manual J design criteria specify key climate and indoor conditions for building design in the area, including an elevation of 5,453 feet, a winter heating temperature of 1°F, and a summer cooling temperature of 91°F. The indoor design temperature is set at 70°F, with a cooling design temperature of 75°F, and humidity levels are 30% in winter and 50% in summer. Wind velocities are noted as 15 mph for heating and 7.5 mph for cooling.
